items.title: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Stock Looks Below Fair Value As Shares Fell 16%
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark stock has fallen 15.9% over the past year, yet an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach currently points to the shares trading at a sizeable discount to that estimate, while broader checks and earnings multiples suggest something closer to a fair price. items.title: Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
items.summary: Household products company Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales flat year on year at $4.19 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.12 per share was 5.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
